acceptance_gate: A decides under a frozen contract, by exact counts over every configuration of the visible bits on the smallest triangular tori, with an independent checker, whether contradictions along a class c are equally likely in the two twists that differ by the dual of c, for three-place and two-literal tiling placements alike. objective: The owner approved the main route from the three-literal epics: test whether the shielding identity of two-literal lone loops survives at three places. In twisted tiling worlds every minimal contradiction winds along a class that the twist, measured from the fitting twist, makes odd. Scoping hinted at paired counts (16 and 16 line cores for placement 155 on 6 x 6). Exactness needs exhaustive counts, so the first step is the smallest tori, where every configuration of the visible bits can be enumerated. The event: the world lifted to the cylinder that keeps c closed still contradicts. It can occur only in the two twists that make c odd relative to the fitting twist, which are exactly the dual pair. Placements that reduce to two-literal worlds are the comparison class. Larger tori would only be sampled.
status: Complete 2026-10-23. Answer: no. Shielding does not survive at three places, and the dividing line is how many places one coin reaches. Proved: cylinders contradict only along classes odd relative to every fitting twist; in orientation worlds (each coin decides one clause on two places) a lone line is exactly the line event of the shielding theorem, so dual pairs are equal on every torus, because rank-two contradictions are seen along every odd class. Measured (frozen experiment, supported, independently checked): once one coin decides three places, every dual pair not related by symmetry is unequal: 36 three-place pairs (factors 1.08 to 2114) and 18 two-literal shared-coin pairs (up to 2) on the fresh 3 x 4 and 4 x 4 tori. No other exact relation between three-place twists appears beyond symmetry. A machine reboot interrupted the run, which was relaunched unchanged. Recommendation: Continue with a fresh epic on the detector (what local structure makes a three-place line see the crossing twist); interest 2/3; deferred to the owner.
stop_rule: One bounded epic. Stop when A has decided under its frozen rule and B has either proved the identity where it holds or explained its failure; do not extend to sampled large tori or new event definitions beyond those frozen in A.
title: Dual pairs for three-place line contradictions
